notes: Draft. LongMemEval-S runs eight namespaces in parallel on one standard-16 VM (about 3 hours, rate limits permitting).

cells.command: MEM0_CHUNK_TURNS=1 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system mem0 --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark locomo --split dev --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-06-oss-memory-shootout/manifests/arms/four-arms-locomo.json --finish-timeout-s 14400 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/mqa"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system mem0; exit $s

MEM0_CHUNK_TURNS=1 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system mem0 --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark locomo --split dev --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-06-oss-memory-shootout/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --ingest-replicate 2 --finish-timeout-s 14400 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/mqa"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system mem0; exit $s

MEM0_CHUNK_TURNS=2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system mem0 --config common --timeout 1800 && { bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark beam-100k --split dev --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-06-oss-memory-shootout/manifests/arms/four-arms-beam-100k.json --finish-timeout-s 14400 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/mqa"; }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system mem0; exit $s

MEM0_CHUNK_TURNS=2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh up --system mem0 --config common --timeout 1800 && { pids=(); for i in $(seq 0 7); do bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark lme-s --limit {{lme_s_limit}} --seed 42 --system http://127.0.0.1:8700 --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-06-oss-memory-shootout/manifests/arms/four-arms-lme-s.json --finish-timeout-s 14400 --shard $i/8 --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/mqa/shard-$i" & pids+=($!); done; s=0; for p in "${pids[@]}"; do wait $p || s=1; done; (exit $s); }; s=$?; bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh down --system mem0; exit $s
